_doc: The reward the Shooter Z AI learns from. One weight per term; the reward of a decision (1/20 s) is the sum of weight x term.
Terms marked helper fade from 100% to 0% over the second half of self-play, so the final AI plays to win, not to farm points.
Every term is logged on its own (reward/<name>), so you can see which part drives the agent.
The benchmark never uses this file: it reports wins, K/D, headshots and damage directly.

Wasted-move costs (marked ramp) start at 0 and grow linearly to their full weight at --ramp-end (default 80% of the run), then stay full: the AI first gets strong, then cleans up its movement. Full from the start, -0.01 outweighed the damage reward (~600 wasted moves/min at first) and the AI got weaker; -0.002 throughout did not stop the spam. Counts per minute are on the dashboard.

won.doc: once, when the match ends in a win (first to the score limit).

lost.doc: once, when the match ends in a loss.

damageDealt.doc: per point of damage dealt (100 = one elimination's worth; headshots already do 2.5x damage).

damageTaken.doc: per point of damage taken. Cover is learned from this; being in cover is never rewarded directly.

wastedShots.doc: per shot that hit nothing (shots - hits). Against spraying.

noProgress.doc: per decision after 10 s with no damage dealt or taken (about -0.1 a second). Against camping; brief waiting is free.

enemyVisible.doc: per decision with an enemy on screen (any ray hits its head, torso, legs or shield). Teaches it to find and keep the enemy in view; fades out with the other helpers.

kills.doc: per elimination (off: damage already covers it).

headshots.doc: per headshot hit, on top of the higher damage (off at first).

crouchSpam.doc: per crouch/stand toggle that undoes the last one within 0.5 s with no shot fired or taken in between (squat spam). Crouch-peeking in a fight stays free.

jumpSpam.doc: per jump with no combat (shots, damage dealt or taken) in the last second. Jumps in a fight stay free; a climbing jump costs this small amount too.

strafeJitter.doc: per left/right strafe reversal within 0.5 s of the last one, while not hit in the last second. Strafe-dodging under fire stays free.

turnJitter.doc: per big turn (1/4 of the turn cap or more) that reverses the last big one within 0.5 s, with no enemy on screen.

abilityWasted.doc: per ability use with no enemy seen and no combat in the last 2 s.
